blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Visual Question Answering (VQA) imposes substantial computational overhead on vision-language models (VLMs), motivating model-agnostic input reduction methods that can be readily applied across diverse VLMs, including in black-box settings. Simply enforcing a visual-token cap reduces computation, but it can discard information needed to answer the question. A single reduction strategy also struggles to accommodate different scenarios. Our key observation is that cropping and compression are complementary: cropping highlights small targets and local details, whereas whole-image compression better preserves context for large targets or distributed evidence. Based on this observation, we propose C$^2$-Routing, which adaptively selects cropping or compression according to the input image and question. Since both strategies may still discard key information, we further design a safety gate that uses the predicted joint correctness distribution under original and reduced inputs to guide fallback and protect accuracy. To accommodate consumer GPU resource constraints, all training and evaluation experiments run on RTX 3090 GPUs. To measure gains beyond token capping, we use full-image baselines with the same cap of 1,024 visual tokens. We conduct extensive evaluation on three VLMs and 18 datasets spanning local details, global scenes, scene text, and documents. With the visual budget already capped, C$^2$-Routing further reduces end-to-end FLOPs by 36.53% and visual tokens by 42.36% on average, with a mean relative task-score decrease of only 0.77%.
blocks.zh: Visual Question Answering(VQA)对视觉语言模型(VLMs)规定了大量的计算间接费用,激发模型不可知的输入还原方法,这些方法可以随时应用于不同的VLM中,包括在黑盒环境中. 仅仅执行可视化键盖会减少计算,但它可以丢弃回答问题所需的信息. 单一的削减战略也难以适应不同的情况。 我们的关键观察是收割和压缩是互补的:收割突出小目标和地方细节,而全图像压缩则能更好地为大目标或分布的证据保存上下文. 基于这一观察,我们提出C$^2$-Routing,它根据输入图像和问题适应性地选择收割或压缩. 由于这两种战略仍然可能丢弃关键信息,我们进一步设计了一个安全门,利用原版和已减少的投入预测的联合正确性分布来引导倒置和保护准确性。 为了适应消费者GPU资源的限制,所有培训和评价实验都运行在RTX 3090 GPU上. 为了衡量超过象征性封顶的收益,我们使用完全图像基线,上限为1 024个可视标志。 我们对三个甚高频和18个数据集进行广泛的评价,这些数据集涉及地方细节、全球场景、场景文本和文件。 由于视觉预算已经封顶,C$^2$-Routing进一步将端到端的FLOP减少36.53%,而视觉信号平均减少42.36%,相对任务分数的平均下降只有0.77%.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have made significant progress in visual understanding and multimodal reasoning [ 15 , 1 , 40 ] . However, the large number of visual tokens generated from images greatly increases computation and memory requirements during inference [ 13 ] , raising deployment and usage costs. In the single-image question-answering example in Fig. 1 (a), Qwen2.5-VL-7B [ 1 ] encodes an image preprocessed to 700 × 1092 700\times 1092 pixels into 975 visual tokens, accounting for 94.1% of the 1,036 input tokens. Reducing visual input while preserving task-relevant information is therefore important for lowering VLM deployment and usage costs.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)在视觉理解和多式联运推理[15, 1, 40]方面取得重大进展. 然而,从图像中产生的大量视觉符号大大增加了推论期间的计算和内存要求[13],提高了部署和使用成本. 在图1(a)中的单图像问答示例中,Quen2.5-VL-7B[1]将一个预处理的图像编码为700×1092700\时的1092像素,变为975个视觉符号,占1,036个输入符号的94.1%. 因此,在保存与任务有关的信息的同时减少视觉输入,对于降低VLM的部署和使用成本十分重要。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Complementary cropping and compression with fallback protection. (a) For targets occupying a small fraction of the full image, cropping highlights the key region, reducing computation and improving accuracy. (b) For large targets or key information distributed across multiple locations, compression preserves global context while reducing computation and maintaining accuracy. (c) When cropping or compression may discard key information, fallback to the original input protects accuracy.
blocks.zh: 图1:利用倒置保护进行补种和压缩。 (a) 对于占完整图像一小部分的目标,裁剪突出关键区域,减少计算和提高准确性。 (b) 对于分布在多个地点的大型目标或关键信息,压缩保持全球背景,同时降低计算和保持准确性。 (c) 当裁剪或压缩可能丢弃关键信息时,回落到原始输入会保护准确性。

blocks.en: Existing studies reduce visual computation primarily through internal visual token reduction or input image processing. Visual token pruning and merging typically rely on model internals [ 5 , 36 , 39 , 35 ] , complicating adaptation across models and limiting their use in black-box settings. Input-level methods process images through question-relevant cropping [ 3 ] , dynamic whole-image resolution adjustment [ 13 , 2 ] , or spatially varying resampling [ 6 ] . However, cropping may discard necessary context, whereas compression may damage key details, limiting the applicability of either strategy alone across scenarios.
blocks.zh: 现有的研究主要通过内部视觉符号减少或输入图像处理来减少视觉计算. 视觉代币的挤压和合并一般依赖于模型内部[5,36,39,35],使模型之间的适应复杂化,并限制了在黑盒环境中的使用. 输入级方法通过与问题相关的裁剪[3],动态整像分辨率调整[13,2],或空间变化的重样[6]处理图像. 然而,作物种植可能会丢弃必要的上下文,而压缩可能会损害关键细节,从而限制这两种战略在各种假设情况下的适用性。

blocks.en: A key finding of this study is that cropping and compression are suited to complementary scenarios, as illustrated in Fig. 1 (a,b). When question-relevant information is concentrated in a small region, whole-image downsampling leaves fewer pixels to represent that region, potentially making answer-relevant details unrecognizable. Cropping removes irrelevant background and increases the key region’s relative prominence, helping the model attend to and recognize the evidence. It can therefore reduce visual tokens and computation while improving accuracy. Conversely, when relevant information spans a large area or is distributed across multiple locations, a crop that retains all relevant content typically removes little background and offers limited computational savings; a tighter crop can discard necessary evidence and context. Moderate whole-image downsampling can instead preserve recognizable evidence and spatial relationships, reducing visual tokens and computation while largely maintaining task performance.
blocks.zh: 如图1(a,b)所示,这项研究的一项关键结论是,作物栽培和压缩适合互补情景。 当与问题有关的信息集中在一个小区域时,整体图像下取样会留下较少的像素来代表这个区域,从而有可能使与答案有关的细节无法识别. 裁剪可以消除无关的背景,提高关键区域的相对知名度,帮助模型关注和识别证据。 因此,它可以减少视觉标志和计算,同时提高准确性. 反之,当有关信息跨越大面积或分布在多个地点时,保留所有相关内容的作物通常会去掉很少的背景,在计算上节省有限;收紧的作物会丢弃必要的证据和上下文。 适度的全图像下采样可以相反地保留可识别的证据和空间关系,减少视觉符号和计算,同时基本保持任务性能.

blocks.en: Furthermore, as shown in Fig. 1 (c), both cropping and compression can remove information needed to answer the question, degrading performance. The input-processing pipeline therefore requires a protection mechanism that falls back to the original input when the predicted risk of performance loss is high. Compared with direct original-input inference, fallback requests incur the extra cost of the decision and preprocessing stages already executed. Nevertheless, the complete pipeline can still reduce overall computation if inference savings from requests without fallback exceed frontend overhead across all requests. Prior work in an EEG-guided setting has shown that selective cropping with fallback to the original input can largely preserve or improve accuracy while reducing overall computation, even after accounting for all stages [ 28 ] .
blocks.zh: 此外,如图1(c)所示,裁剪和压缩可以删除回答问题所需的信息,降低性能。 因此,投入处理管道需要一种保护机制,在预期性能损失风险很高时恢复到原始投入。 与直接的原始投入推论相比,回扣请求产生了决定和已执行的预处理阶段的额外费用。 然而,如果从请求中节省的不回落费用超过所有请求的前端间接费用,整个管道仍可减少总体计算。 以前在以电子工程专家组为指南的环境下进行的工作表明,即使在计算所有阶段[28]之后,有选择地进行回落到原始输入的裁剪在很大程度上仍可保持或提高准确性,同时减少总体计算。

blocks.en: Based on these observations, we propose C 2 -Routing, a visual input router that combines complementary reduction strategies with accuracy protection. Its core design separates strategy selection from risk assessment. The former chooses cropping or whole-image compression based on the image and question, exploiting their strengths for different spatial distributions of task-relevant information. The latter estimates the chosen reduction’s performance impact relative to the original input to decide whether to retain it or fall back. To assess how input reduction affects accuracy, we model the joint distribution of answer correctness under the original and reduced inputs. Strategy selection and risk prediction share an image–question representation to reduce frontend overhead. All routing and fallback decisions precede target inference and require no access to target-model internals, enabling black-box use.
blocks.zh: 基于这些观察,我们提出C 2-Routing,一种视觉输入路由器,将互补的减少策略与精度保护结合起来. 其核心设计将战略选择与风险评估分开。 前者根据图像和问题选择裁剪或整像压缩,利用其长处为任务相关信息的不同空间分布. 后者估计了所选择的削减对原投入的绩效影响,以决定是保留还是退缩。 为了评估投入减少如何影响准确性,我们在原投入和减少投入下对答案正确性的联合分布进行模拟. 战略选择和风险预测共享图像-问题表述以减少前端间接费用。 所有路由和后退决定都先于目标推断,不需要进入目标模型内部,从而能够使用黑箱.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of C 2 -Routing. Shared image–question features guide cropping or compression. A risk head predicts joint answer correctness under original and reduced inputs, allowing the safety gate to accept the reduction or fall back to the original image. The VLM answers from the resulting image and question.
blocks.zh: 图2:C2-Routing概览. 共享图像 - 问题特性指导裁剪或压缩 。 一个风险头在原始和减少输入下预测联合答案正确性,使得安全门能够接受减少或倒回原始图像. VLM从由此产生的图像和问题中解答.

blocks.en: Our full-image budget comparison shows that a visual-token cap alone considerably reduces computation at an accuracy cost. This observation highlights the role of visual budgets in efficiency evaluation. We therefore compare methods against full-image baselines with the same cap of 1,024 visual tokens to measure the additional savings and accuracy changes due to input routing. We jointly control visual budgets and frontend costs to meet consumer GPU resource constraints, running all training and evaluation experiments on RTX 3090 GPUs. Experiments on three VLMs and 18 datasets show that our method further reduces end-to-end computation while protecting accuracy under an already restricted visual budget.
blocks.zh: 我们的全图像预算比较表明,光是视觉卡片就可以大大降低精确成本的计算。 这一意见突出了视觉预算在效率评价中的作用。 因此,我们将方法与全图像基线进行比较,同为1 024个视觉符号的上限,以衡量由于输入路径而带来的额外节省和准确性变化。 我们联合控制视觉预算和前端费用,以满足消费GPU资源限制,在RTX 3090GPU上进行所有培训和评价实验. 对3个VLM和18个数据集的实验表明,我们的方法进一步减少了端到端的计算,同时在已经受到限制的视觉预算下保护准确性.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are: • Complementarity-driven input routing. We identify the complementary strengths of cropping and compression for local-detail and global-context tasks, and propose C 2 -Routing to select the strategy without accessing target-model internals, enabling black-box use. • Accuracy protection through joint correctness prediction. We jointly model answer correctness under original and reduced inputs to distinguish harmful from beneficial reductions, guiding fallback to protect accuracy. • Visual budgets in efficiency evaluation. Full-image budget comparisons reveal significant computational savings and an accuracy cost from token capping alone. Comparisons against full-image baselines with the same cap quantify the additional gains from input routing. • Broad evaluation under consumer GPU constraints. All training and evaluation experiments run on RTX 3090 GPUs. Experiments on three VLMs and 18 datasets show that, even when the visual-token budget is already capped, our method further reduces computation after accounting for all frontend overhead while largely preserving accuracy, demonstrating its effectiveness and broad applicability under resource constraints.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献是: • 互补驱动的投入路线。 我们确定作物裁剪和压缩对于本地细节和全球文本任务的互补性优势,并提议C 2-Routing在不访问目标模型内部的情况下选择策略,允许黑箱使用. • 通过联合正确性预测进行准确性保护。 我们联合模型在原始和减少的投入下回答正确性,以区分有害和有利减少,引导回落以保护准确性。 • 效率评价的视觉预算。 完全图像预算比较显示,仅象征性封顶就可节省大量计算费用和准确性成本。 与全图像基线和同一上限的比较量化了输入路由带来的额外收益。 · 在消费者GPU的限制下进行广泛的评价。 所有培训和评价实验都运行在RTX 3090 GPU上. 对3个甚高频和18个数据集的实验表明,即使视盘预算已经封顶,我们的方法在计算所有前端间接费用之后进一步减少计算,同时在很大程度上保持了准确性,显示了它在资源限制下的有效性和广泛适用性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Visual Token Pruning and Merging
blocks.zh: 2.1 视觉Token冲洗和合并

blocks.en: Visual token pruning and merging use internal attention or hidden representations to remove or merge redundant tokens at the vision encoder output or within language-model layers [ 5 , 36 , 39 , 35 ] . For example, VisionZip [ 36 ] and HiPrune [ 18 ] both use attention information from the vision encoder to reduce the number of visual tokens passed to the language model. Such changes require access to model internals, complicating adaptation across models and preventing application in settings where only input–output interfaces are available, for example, GPT-4V APIs [ 26 , 27 ] . C 2 -Routing instead crops or resizes input images before inference, avoiding model-specific modifications.
blocks.zh: 视觉代号浏览和合并使用内部注意或隐藏的表示,在视觉编码器输出或语言模型层中去除或合并冗余代号[5,36,39,35]. 例如,VisionZip[36]和HiPrune[18]都使用视觉编码器的注意信息,以减少传递到语言模型的视觉符号数量. 这种变化需要访问模型内部,使各种模型的适应复杂化,并防止在只有输入-输出接口的情况下应用,例如,GPT-4V API [26,27]. C 2 - 在推论前调整输入图像的大小,避免模型特定修改.

blocks.en: 2.2 Input-Level Image Processing
blocks.zh: 2.2 输入级图像处理

blocks.en: Cropping and visual search. Cropping and visual search improve fine-detail recognition by highlighting question-relevant local information, but existing approaches have limitations in model independence and inference cost. ViCrop [ 38 ] and GapSight [ 41 ] require access to target-model internal states, while AdaptVision [ 17 ] requires training the target model, limiting their adaptation across models and applicability to black-box settings. ViCrop [ 38 ] and ZoomEye [ 29 ] improve accuracy through visual cropping and iterative region exploration, respectively, at the cost of additional computation compared with direct full-image inference. CropVLM [ 3 ] combines a low-resolution full image with a learned crop to avoid encoding the full image at high resolution. Moreover, when the target object occupies a large fraction of the image or multiple relevant targets are spatially dispersed, cropping alone often offers limited computational savings and may discard key information needed to answer the question.
blocks.zh: 裁剪与视觉搜索. 裁剪和视觉搜索通过突出与问题有关的当地信息,改进了细微的识别,但现有方法在模型独立性和推论成本上有局限性. ViCrop [38]和GapSight [41]需要访问目标模型内部状态,而Adapition Vision [17]则需要培训目标模型,限制其跨模型的适应性,并适用于黑盒设置. ViCrop [38] 和 ZoomEye [29] 分别通过视觉裁剪和迭代区域探索提高准确度,与直接全图像推论相比,成本增加. CropVLM [3] 将低分辨率的全图像与学得的作物结合,以避免在高分辨率时将全图像编码. 此外,当目标物体占据图像的很大一部分或多个相关目标在空间上分散时,单靠裁剪往往能节省有限的计算,并可能丢弃回答问题所需的关键信息.

blocks.en: Dynamic compression. Dynamic compression reduces visual redundancy while preserving global context by selecting whole-image resolution or adjusting spatial sampling density, but limitations remain in deployment flexibility and inference cost. VisionThink [ 37 ] uses reinforcement learning to train the target model to request higher resolution as needed, limiting its direct applicability to frozen black-box models. CARES [ 13 ] and input-adaptive preprocessing [ 2 ] select input resolution before target-model inference using low-resolution proxy features and image-complexity measures, respectively, but may underestimate local detail requirements. Spatially non-uniform sampling methods like [ 8 ] and [ 6 ] interpolate sampled images back to their original resolution; the latter also incurs extra inference cost through repeated target-model calls during iterative optimization for each image. Even when compression preserves details in key regions, it may not increase their proportion of the full image, leaving small targets difficult for the model to notice.
blocks.zh: 动态压缩. 动态压缩通过选择全图像分辨率或调整空间采样密度来减少视觉冗余,同时保留全局环境,但部署灵活性和推论成本方面仍存在局限性. VisionThink [37] 利用强化学习来训练目标模型,视需要要求更高的分辨率,将其直接应用限制在冷冻黑盒模型上. CAES [13] 和输入适应预处理 [2] 在目标模型推论前选择输入分辨率,分别使用低分辨率的代理特性和图像复杂度测量,但可能会低估本地细节要求. 空间上非统一取样方法,如[8]和[6]将取样图像内插到原始分辨率;在迭代优化每个图像时,通过重复的目标模型调用,后者也会产生额外推论费用。 即使压缩保存了关键区域的细节,也可能不会增加其在完整图像中的比例,使得模型难以注意到小目标.

blocks.en: C 2 -Routing dynamically combines cropping and compression within an input-routing framework, exploiting their complementarity in local-detail and global-context scenarios to address a broader range of visual tasks. We predict the joint distribution of answer correctness under original and reduced inputs to guide fallback and protect accuracy. The method requires neither modifying the VLM nor accessing its internals, making it model-agnostic and easy to apply across models.
blocks.zh: C级 2- 动态循环在输入路径框架内将裁剪和压缩结合起来,利用它们在当地细节和全局背景情景中的互补性,处理更广泛的视觉任务。 我们预测在原始和减少投入下,共同分配答案正确性,以引导回落和保护准确性。 该方法既不要求修改VLM,也不要求访问其内部,使它具有模型不可知性,易于跨模型应用.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: Fig. 2 presents C 2 -Routing, a model-agnostic frontend that selects and protects visual information before VLM inference. A frozen lightweight encoder first extracts shared features from the image and question. A selection head chooses cropping to emphasize local details or whole-image compression to preserve broader context with fewer visual tokens. The crop branch localizes a question-relevant region; the compression branch uses a resolution head to select a token budget for image compression.
blocks.zh: 图2呈现了C 2-Routing,一种模型不可知的前端,在VLM推论前选择和保护视觉信息. 冷冻的轻量级编码器首先从图像和问题中提取了共享的特征. 选择头选择裁剪以强调本地细节或全图像压缩,以用较少的视觉符号来保存更广泛的上下文. 裁剪分支将一个与问题相关的区域本地化;压缩分支使用分辨率头来选择用于图像压缩的符号预算.

blocks.en: The active branch’s risk head predicts joint answer correctness under the original and proposed reduced inputs, using frontend features. A safety gate uses this prediction to accept the reduction or fall back to the original input. The resulting image and original question are then passed to the frozen target VLM. Thus adaptive selection exploits crop–compression complementarity, while the safety gate protects accuracy when the proposed reduction loses essential information. All input decisions use frontend features, and the target VLM is called once with the resulting image.

blocks.en: 3.2 Adaptive Cropping and Compression
blocks.zh: 3.2 适应性裁剪和压缩

blocks.en: Whether to crop or compress an image depends on its content and the visual information required by the question. Even for the same image, reading small text in a local region may favor cropping, whereas reasoning about relationships among multiple objects may require broader context and favor compression. The router must therefore analyze the image and question together to identify relevant visual information and choose a reduction that preserves it. To balance this capability with routing overhead, a small VLM extracts joint image–question features shared by subsequent decision modules.
blocks.zh: 是否裁剪或压缩一个图像取决于其内容和问题所需的视觉信息. 即使对同一图像来说,在局部地区读取小文本也可能倾向于裁剪,而关于多个对象之间关系的推理可能需要更广泛的上下文和偏好压缩. 因此,路由器必须一起分析图像并提问,以识别相关的视觉信息,并选择保存它的减少. 为了平衡这种能力与路由管理费用的关系,一个小型VLM提取了联合图像-问题特征,与随后的决定模块相同。

blocks.en: Shared image–question features. For an image–question pair x i = ( I i , Q i ) x_{i}=(I_{i},Q_{i}) , we use frozen SmolVLM-500M [ 22 ] as the frontend encoder E E and follow the feature extraction of CARES [ 13 ] to obtain h i = E ⁡ ( I i , Q i ) h_{i}=E(I_{i},Q_{i}) , the shared image–question features. The selection and resolution heads reuse this representation to consider image content and question requirements without repeated encoding. Both heads use lightweight classifiers to limit decision overhead.

blocks.en: Strategy Selection. We separate input reduction into strategy selection and compression-budget selection: the former determines whether to emphasize a local region or preserve whole-image context, while the latter determines how much visual detail to retain when keeping the whole image. The selection head first chooses cropping or compression from h i h_{i} . On the crop branch, frozen Grounding DINO-tiny [ 19 ] localizes a question-relevant region, and cropping increases its relative prominence in the input. On the compression branch, the resolution head selects a visual-token cap of 256 or 512 and adjusts the whole-image resolution accordingly.

blocks.en: 3.3 Safety Gate for Accuracy Protection
blocks.zh: 3.3 准确性保护的安全门

blocks.en: Because cropping and compression can discard answer-relevant information, we design a safety gate to decide whether to fall back to the original input. Predicting reduced-input errors alone is insufficient: fallback cannot correct them if the original input also fails. Conversely, reduction may highlight key regions or reduce irrelevant distractions, yielding a correct answer where the original input fails; fallback would then make the answer incorrect. We therefore jointly model answer correctness under the original and reduced inputs to distinguish harm that fallback can correct from benefits it may forfeit.
blocks.zh: 由于裁剪和压缩可以丢弃与答案相关的信息,我们设计了一个安全门,以决定是否回到原始输入. 仅预测减少输入错误是不够的:如果原始输入也失败,倒计时不能纠正。 相反,减少可能会突出关键区域或减少无关的分散注意力,从而在原始输入失败时产生正确的答案;回落会使答案不正确。 因此,我们联合模型在原始和减少投入下回答正确性,以区分可弥补的伤害和可能丧失的利益。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Data and splitting. Our pool contains 206,996 questions from 18 datasets [ 12 , 23 , 24 , 31 , 25 , 7 , 4 , 20 , 9 , 16 , 34 , 21 , 14 , 11 , 30 , 10 , 33 , 32 ] covering local detail, global context, text/document understanding, and mixed perception. To prevent data leakage, we group samples from the same image or document and merge groups sharing the same source across datasets. Using a fixed random seed, we divide the groups into training, validation, and test sets in an approximate 4:2:4 ratio, yielding 83,902, 40,874, and 82,220 samples, respectively.
blocks.zh: 数据与分割. 我们的集合包含来自18个数据集的206,996个问题[12,23,24,31,25,7,4,20,9,16,34,21,14,11,30,10,33,32],涵盖地方细节,全局背景,文本/文件理解,以及混合认知. 为了防止数据泄露,我们从同一图像或文档中组别样本,并将共享同一源的组合并到各数据集. 我们利用固定的随机种子,将各组分为训练、验证和测试组,比例约为4:2:4,分别产生83,902、40,874和82,220个样本。

blocks.en: For each target model, we train one router on the pooled training sets from all 18 datasets and use the pooled validation set for model and configuration selection. We then evaluate the selected configuration on each dataset’s test set. We average results equally across the 18 datasets. We repeat router training and validation-set configuration selection with four seeds and report their mean results.
blocks.zh: 在每个目标模型中,我们从所有18个数据集中就集合培训集培训一个路由器,并利用集合验证集进行模型和配置选择。 然后我们在每个数据集的测试集上评价选定的配置。 我们平均在18个数据集中取得同样的结果。 我们用四个种子重复路由器培训和验证设置配置选择,并报告其平均结果。

blocks.en: Targets and budgets. We evaluate frozen Qwen2.5-VL-7B and -3B [ 1 ] , and InternVL3-8B [ 40 ] , with all training and evaluation on RTX 3090 GPUs. To accommodate consumer GPU resources and measure routing gains beyond budget restriction, the original-input and crop paths use a 1,024-token cap; compression uses 256- or 512-token caps. M and A denote two router variants: the selection head uses shared image–question features in M and additionally receives a question-derived task category in A. We report Safe and Balanced configurations, prioritizing accuracy retention and computational savings, respectively.
blocks.zh: 目标和预算。 我们评估了被冻结的Qwen2.5-VL-7B和-3B[1],以及InternVL3-8B[40],并对RTX 3090 GPU进行了所有培训和评估。 为了容纳消费的GPU资源并衡量超出预算限制的路由收益,原始投入和作物路径使用1 024个托肯盖;压缩使用256个或512个托肯盖. M和A表示两个路由器变体:选择头使用共享的图像-M中的问题特性,另外收到A中的问题生成任务类别. 我们报告安全和平衡配置,分别优先考虑准确性保留和计算节余。

blocks.en: Comparisons. We compare with CARES [ 13 ] , CropVLM [ 3 ] , ViCrop [ 38 ] , and ZoomEye [ 29 ] . CARES is our closest baseline: it shares the goal of reducing computation and visual tokens while preserving performance, and uses a model-agnostic frontend. We cap it at 1,024 visual tokens and retrain its resolution selector, denoting this version CARES-F1024. CropVLM combines an original image and a learned crop. We cap both at 512 visual tokens each, giving a total cap of 1,024, and denote this setting CropVLM-F1024. Its crop constructor is selected on validation data, and its cost is included. The selected constructor uses a 2,048-pixel longest-edge setting for localization. ViCrop and ZoomEye primarily improve fine-detail perception through cropping; ZoomEye is also model-agnostic. We retain their multi-image inputs and repeated calls, evaluating ViCrop at 256 or 1,024 tokens per image and ZoomEye at up to 1,024. All calls count toward end-to-end FLOPs. ViCrop uses the official Qwen2.5-VL relative-attention implementation; no official InternVL3-8B implementation was available.
blocks.zh: 比较. 我们比较了CAES [13], CropVLM [3],ViCrop [38],和ZomEye [29]. CAES是我们最接近的基线:它共同的目标是在保留性能的同时减少计算和视觉信号,并使用模型不可知的前端. 我们把它封顶在1 024个视觉标志 并重新训练它的分辨率选择器, 表示这个版本 CAESS-F1024。 CropVLM结合了一个原始图像和一个学习过的作物. 我们把两者都封顶在512个视觉标志上,总共封顶为1 024个,并表示这个设置CropVLM-F1024。 其作物构造器根据验证数据选定,成本计入. 所选的构造器使用2,048像素最长的对角设置进行本地化. ViCrop和ZoomEye主要通过裁剪改善精细的感知;ZoomEye也是模型不可知的. 我们保留了他们的多图像输入和反复呼唤,评价ViCrop每幅图像为256或1,024令牌,ZoomEye为1,024. 所有电话都算在FLOP上 ViCrop采用正式的Quen2.5-VL相对注意执行;没有正式的InternVL3-8B执行.

blocks.en: 4.2 Preliminary Study
blocks.zh: 4.2 初步研究

blocks.en: To distinguish method gains from budget effects, we first examine a visual-token cap alone, without adaptive cropping or compression. We evaluate Qwen2.5-VL-7B on 672 questions from four representative datasets—V* [ 33 ] , DocVQA [ 24 ] , RealWorldQA [ 34 ] , and AI2D [ 12 ] . Lowering the cap from 16,384 to 1,024 with other inference settings fixed saves 55.64% FLOPs and 54.32% visual tokens, with a 0.63-point mean score loss. Peak allocated GPU memory for target inference falls from 18.81 to 15.75 GiB. This saving with limited average score loss motivates our 1,024-token original-input baseline, against which we measure each method’s additional FLOPs and token savings (Appendix C.1 ).
blocks.zh: 为了将方法收益与预算影响区分开来,我们首先只检查一个可视的托盘盖,而不进行适应性的裁剪或压缩. 我们对四个有代表性的数据集——V* [33]、DocVQA [24]、RealWorldQA [34]和AI2D [12]——的672个问题进行了评价。 将上限从16,384个降至1,024个,其他推论设置固定,可节省55.64%的FLOP和54.32%的视觉符号,平均分值损失为0.63分. Peak为目标推断分配的GPU内存从18.81降至15.75 GiB. 这一节省加上有限的平均得分损失,激发了我们1 024个原投入基准,我们参照这些基准衡量每种方法的额外FLOP和象征性节省(附录C.1)。

blocks.en: 4.3 Overall Performance
blocks.zh: 4.3 总体业绩

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , with the original input already capped at 1,024 visual tokens, our method generally reduces end-to-end computation and visual-token consumption while largely retaining task performance across three target models and 18 datasets. Balanced-A saves an average of 36.53% of end-to-end FLOPs and 42.36% of visual tokens while retaining 99.23% of the task score. Safe configurations prioritize accuracy retention: Safe-A saves 19.35–25.32% of end-to-end FLOPs across the three models, with mean score decreases of 0.19 and less than 0.01 percentage points on Qwen2.5-VL-7B and -3B, respectively, and a gain of 0.85 points on InternVL3-8B. Full per-dataset results are provided in Appendix A.2 . Generalization to held-out datasets is evaluated in Appendix A.6 .
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,由于原始输入额已上限为1,024个视觉符号,我们的方法一般减少端到端的计算和可视化的消耗,同时基本上保留了三个目标模型和18个数据集的任务性能. 平衡A平均节省了36.53%的端对端FLOP和42.36%的视觉信号,同时保留99.23%的任务分数. 安全配置优先保留精度: Safe-A节省了19.35–25.32%的端对端FLOP横跨三种模式,在Qun2.5-VL-7B和-3B上,平均得分分别下降0.19和不足0.01个百分点,在InternVL3-8B上则获得0.85分. 每个数据集的全部结果见附录A.2。 附录A.6对被搁置数据集的一般情况进行了评估。

blocks.en: Compared with CARES-F1024 [ 13 ] , Balanced-A achieves a higher mean task score and greater end-to-end FLOPs and visual-token savings on all three models (Appendix A.4 ). Across models, mean task score improves by 1.11 percentage points, and FLOPs savings relative to the original input rise from 32.87% to 36.53%.
blocks.zh: 与CAESS-F1024 [13],平衡- A实现更高的平均任务分数,并在所有三种模型上实现更高的端对端FLOP和可视化托能节省(Appendix A.4 . 在整个模型中,平均任务分数提高了1.11个百分点,与原始投入相比,FLOPs的储蓄率从32.87%上升到36.53%.

blocks.en: Per-dataset results show smaller worst-case losses and variation than CARES-F1024 (Appendix A.5 ). Across models, CARES-F1024’s largest gains are 0.72–2.97 points and its largest losses 5.40–13.83 points. Balanced-A’s largest gains are 3.92–9.16 points and losses 3.03–4.32 points; Safe-A’s are 2.93–9.65 and 1.30–2.21 points, respectively. Both routing configurations have lower cross-dataset variation than CARES-F1024 on all three models, with Safe configurations limiting the largest losses.
blocks.zh: 与CAES-F1024(附录A.5)相比,每组数据显示的损失和变化较小。 在各种模型中,CAES-F1024的最大收益为0.72–2.97分,最大的损失为5.40–13.83分。 平衡-A的最大收益为3.92–9.16分,损失为3.03–4.32分;安全-A的得分分别为2.93–9.65分和1.30–2.21分. 两种路由配置的跨数据集变异在所有三种模型上都低于CAES-F1024,安全配置限制了最大的损失.

blocks.en: CropVLM-F1024 retains 97.40%, 97.82%, and 98.55% of the task score on 7B, 3B, and InternVL3-8B, but increases end-to-end FLOPs by 35.93%, 56.23%, and 49.68%, respectively. These costs include generating the crop and running the VLM on both the original image and crop.
blocks.zh: CropVLM-F1024在7B,3B和InternVL3-8B上保留了97.40%,97.82%,98.55%的任务分数,但端对端FLOP分别增加了35.93%,56.23%和49.68%. 这些费用包括产生作物和在原始图像和作物上运行VLM。

blocks.en: ViCrop [ 38 ] and ZoomEye [ 29 ] illustrate a different tradeoff, improving visual perception through additional computation. With 1,024 visual tokens per image, ViCrop improves mean task scores by 0.49–0.97 percentage points on the two Qwen models, but uses approximately 3.03 × 3.03\times the end-to-end FLOPs of the original input. ZoomEye improves scores by 2.07–3.23 points across the three models at 24.29 24.29 – 53.79 × 53.79\times the computation. Although ViCrop’s 256-token setting reduces visual tokens in the final answer call, its end-to-end computation remains higher than the original input and its task scores decrease.

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.5 阅读研究

blocks.en: Cropping and compression branches. We ablate the cropping and compression branches in Balanced-A (Table 2 ). Removing cropping lowers mean local-detail task scores by 4.56, 1.22, and 0.43 percentage points on 7B, 3B, and InternVL3-8B, respectively, compared with only 0.12, 0.01, and 0.00 points on global-context tasks. Cropping’s benefits are therefore concentrated in local-detail tasks. Removing compression reduces computational savings on all 18 datasets for each model, leaving mean end-to-end FLOPs savings of 9.01%, -0.09%, and -3.60%, respectively. The branches thus make different contributions: cropping improves local-detail performance, while compression provides computational savings across a broader range of tasks. Task-group results are provided in Appendix B.1 .
blocks.zh: 裁剪和压缩分支. 我们在平衡A中减少收割和压缩树枝(表2)。 取消作物栽培下限意味着本地-细节任务分数分别为4.56,1.22,7B,3B和InternVL3-8B的0.43个百分点,而全球背景任务只有0.12,0.01和0.00个百分点. 因此,作物的效益集中在当地详细的任务上。 删除压缩会减少每个模型所有18个数据集的计算节省,使平均端到端的FLOP节省率分别为9.01%,-0.9%和-3.60%. 因此,这些分支做出了不同的贡献:裁剪提高了本地-详细性能,而压缩则在更广泛的任务中提供计算节约. 工作队的成果见附录B.1。

blocks.en: Safety gate. We conduct an ablation study on the safety gate (Table 3 ). In Balanced-A, enabling both gates reduces the three-model mean score loss from 1.583 to 0.462 points, while FLOPs saving changes from 42.87% to 36.53%. The compression gate provides most of the accuracy recovery. Adding the crop gate slightly lowers the mean Balanced-A score but improves Safe-A by 0.057 points on average, including 0.191 points on 3B. Complete ablations are provided in Appendix B.2 .
blocks.zh: 安全门 我们对安全门进行消毒研究(表3)。 在Balanced-A中,两座闸门都能将三型平均分数损失从1.583分降至0.462分,而FLOPs则将变化从42.87%降至36.53%. 压缩闸机提供了大部分精度回收. 加上作物门将平均平衡A分略低,但安全A分平均提高0.057分,包括3B的0.191分. 附录B.2提供了完整的清单。

blocks.en: 4.6 FLOPs, Latency, and GPU Memory
blocks.zh: 4.6 FLOPs、Latience和GPU内存

blocks.en: Computational breakdown. Target VLM inference uses 95.34–96.94% of end-to-end FLOPs (Table 4 ). Shared feature extraction dominates frontend cost at 2.60–3.95%; the prediction heads together use less than 0.01%.
blocks.zh: 计算分解. 目标VLM推论使用95.34-96.94%的端对端FLOP(表4). 共享的特征提取占前端成本的2.60–3.95%;预测头总使用率不到0.01%.

blocks.en: Enabling the gate reduces mean end-to-end FLOPs savings by about 6.3 percentage points (Sec. 4.5 ), mainly by running the target VLM on original rather than reduced inputs; frontend computation barely changes. Further savings therefore depend on avoiding unnecessary fallback while preserving accuracy, rather than reducing the already negligible head computation.
blocks.zh: 启用闸门将平均端到端的FLOP节省约6.3个百分点(Sec. 4.5),主要通过在原版上运行目标VLM而不是减少输入;前端计算勉强改变. 因此,进一步的节省取决于在保持准确性的同时避免不必要的倒退,而不是减少本已微不足道的头部计算。

blocks.en: Latency. On one RTX 3090, we time Qwen2.5-VL-7B on 180 questions (10 per dataset) with three repeats. Mean latency, including preprocessing and the frontend, is 0.765, 0.618, and 0.659 s for F1024, CARES-F1024, and Balanced-A, respectively. Relative to F1024, Balanced-A reduces latency by 13.72% averaged across datasets (95% CI: 9.47–17.52%). Compared with CARES, its faster target-model stage is offset by higher frontend overhead. Details are in Appendix C.4 .
blocks.zh: 即时. 在一个RTX 3090上,我们给180个问题(每个数据集10个)的Qwen2.5-VL-7B计时,重复三次. F1024、CAES-F1024和A平衡号的平均延迟,包括预处理和前端分别是0.765、0.618和0.659秒。 相对于F1024, 平衡-A将不同数据集的延迟平均减少13.72%(95% CI: 9.47-17.52%)。 与援外社相比,其更快的目标模型阶段被前端较高的间接费用所抵消。 详情见附录C.4。

blocks.en: Deployment memory. With a visual-token cap of 1,024 and batch size 1, the complete pipeline runs on a single 24GB RTX 3090 for all three targets, with both the router frontend and target VLM loaded on the same GPU. Peak allocated GPU memory is 11.01–19.43 GiB. Measurement settings and per-model results are in Appendix C.3 .
blocks.zh: 部署记忆。 拥有可视化的1024顶和批量尺寸1,完整的管道运行在单一的24GB RTX 3090上,所有三个目标,路由器前端和目标VLM都装载在同一GPU上. 峰值分配的GPU内存为11.01–19.43 GiB. 测量设置和按模型计算的结果载于附录C.3。

blocks.en: 4.7 Combination with Visual Token Pruning
blocks.zh: 4.7 与视觉托肯普鲁宁结合

blocks.en: C 2 -Routing processes images before they enter the VLM, whereas token pruning operates inside the model. Since these methods act at different stages, they can be applied together. We test this combination using VisionZip [ 36 ] on Qwen2.5-VL-7B at 70% token retention. Direct combination keeps our router unchanged; adaptation retrains its frontend heads using the pruned VLM’s answers.
blocks.zh: C级 2-在图像进入VLM前进行循环处理,而在模型内进行符号冲洗。 由于这些方法在不同阶段运作,它们可以一起应用. 我们使用VisionZip[36]在Quen2.5-VL-7B上以70%的象征性保留来测试这个组合. 直接组合不会改变我们的路由器; 适应性会使用被pruned VLM 的答案重排其前端头部 。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 5 , adding our router to VisionZip increases end-to-end FLOPs savings from 20.39% to 50.29% and visual-token savings from 30.13% to 61.13%, with an additional 1.10-point score loss. With adaptation, the combination improves mean score by 0.65 points over VisionZip alone, while increasing FLOPs savings to 29.44% and token savings to 42.15%. Additional results and analysis are provided in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 如表5所示,在VisionZip中加入我们的路由器,将终端到终端的FLOPs的节省率从20.39%提高到50.29%,将可视化的存储率从30.13%提高到61.13%,再增加1.10分的积分损失. 适应后,组合单比VisionZip提高0.65分,同时将FLOP储蓄提高到29.44%,象征性储蓄提高到42.15%. 附录D提供了其他结果和分析。

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5. 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Our main results measure routing gains over a capped baseline. Fully separating savings from the cap and from routing across all models and datasets remains future work, as our cap study covers only one model and four datasets.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要成果是衡量航向收益高于上限基线。 我们的封顶研究仅涵盖一个模型和四个数据集,因此,从封顶和所有模型和数据集的路由中充分区分节余仍然是今后的工作。

blocks.en: The crop safety gate shows potential, but its accuracy gains vary across models and configurations. A more reliable fallback criterion is needed to protect accuracy while preserving beneficial crops.
blocks.zh: 作物安全门显示出潜力,但其精度收益因模型和配置而异. 为了保护准确性,同时保护有利的作物,需要有一个更可靠的回落标准。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We find that a visual-token cap alone substantially reduces computation with a small average performance loss. We therefore measure our method’s additional gains over capped original inputs. In this setting, we propose C 2 -Routing, which exploits the complementarity of cropping and compression to reduce computation and visual-token consumption, and uses a safety gate to guide fallback and protect accuracy. We conduct extensive evaluation on 3 VLMs and 18 datasets. With original inputs already capped at 1,024 visual tokens, our main configuration further saves an average of 36.53% in end-to-end FLOPs and 42.36% in visual tokens while retaining 99.23% of the task score. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B, our pipeline also reduces end-to-end latency by 13.72% on an RTX 3090.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,光是可视化的盖子就大大减少了计算,因为平均性能损失很小。 因此,我们衡量我们方法的额外收益,而不是限制原始投入。 在此情况下,我们提出C 2 - Routing,它利用裁剪和压缩的互补性来减少计算和可视化的消耗,并使用安全门来引导倒置和保护准确性. 我们对3个甚高频和18个数据集进行了广泛的评价。 由于原始输入量已经上限为1,024个视觉信使,我们的主要配置进一步节省了平均36.53%的终到FLOP和42.36%的视觉信使,同时保留99.23%的任务分数. 在Quen2.5-VL-7B上,我们的输油管在RTX 3090上还减少了13.72%的端对端延迟.

blocks.en: We divide the 18 datasets into three folds of six. For each fold, we retrain the router and select its configuration using only the other 12 datasets, then evaluate on the held-out datasets’ original test splits. Shared source groups belonging to a held-out dataset are excluded from training and validation. All learned upstream modules are retrained; only frozen input features, constructor outputs, and target outcomes are reused. The experiment covers 3 target models and four training seeds. Each dataset is tested once per seed, and Table S11 averages the resulting held-out scores.

blocks.en: Budget stress test. On 36 inputs spanning all 18 datasets, each target retains its main attention backend and generation settings. blocks.en: We compare F 1024 F_{1024} , CARES- F 1024 F_{1024} , and Balanced-A on Qwen2.5-VL-7B using one RTX 3090 at batch size 1, with BF16 precision and the main eager-attention setting. Seeded hashes select one test question from each of 10 natural image/document groups per dataset, giving 180 questions across all 18 datasets. The sample selection does not use answers or routing decisions. Balanced-A uses the frozen router with both safety gates; CARES uses its continuous resolution selector.

blocks.en: All methods run with the same prompt and generation settings for each dataset. The target and frontend models remain loaded on the GPU, and each request recomputes its frontend features. After six warmup requests per method and an untimed crop pass to initialize the localizer, we measure three repetitions with balanced method order, yielding 1,620 timed requests. GPU synchronization brackets frontend execution and the target call. Timing includes image/question preprocessing, online routing and localization when selected, and answer generation; model loading and disk image decoding are excluded. Continuous GPU monitoring records no other compute or graphics processes during the measurements.

blocks.en: Table S22 reports aggregate and per-dataset results. We first average repetitions per question and questions per dataset. Overall times average the 18 dataset means; overall savings average the relative savings within each dataset. Confidence intervals use 5,000 paired bootstrap resamples of natural image/document groups. Balanced-A reduces latency on 13 of the 18 datasets. Its target-model stage is slightly faster than CARES, but higher frontend overhead increases total latency. High-resolution inputs are particularly affected: HR-Bench 8K uses compression for all sampled questions yet has substantial frontend time, indicating that latency overhead is not confined to localization.

blocks.en: Direct combination. We apply VisionZip [ 36 ] after input routing, keeping the existing Balanced-A router from seed 0 fixed. Original-input and routed-image inference are evaluated at 100%, 70%, and 50% token retention on all 82,220 test questions across 18 datasets. Matched inference reruns give scores of 67.04 for the unpruned original input and 66.49 for routing alone. Direct combination at 70% retention saves 50.29% of end-to-end FLOPs and 61.13% of visual tokens with a 1.38-point score loss; at 50%, savings reach 57.65% and 72.27%, with a 3.95-point loss. These results use one frozen router; the main standalone comparison averages four training seeds.

blocks.en: Stronger pruning and fallback. At 50% retention, adapted Balanced-A reduces score loss by 2.42 points relative to direct combination, but sacrifices 21.07 percentage points of FLOPs savings. Compared with the unpruned matched-data control, adapted 50% increases token savings from 43.97% to 54.92%, but FLOPs savings fall from 39.41% to 36.58% and score loss rises from 1.11 to 1.54 points. Its original-image fallback rate is 78.39%, compared with 16.41% for the unpruned matched-data control, averaged equally across datasets. Returning to the original image reduces input-processing savings while leaving pruning active. On InfoVQA and DocVQA, the adapted model falls back on 99.91% and 99.94% of samples, yet loses 11.43 and 5.02 points; pruning the original image alone loses 11.43 and 5.01 points. These cases show why fallback cannot remove information loss caused by pruning the original input. For adapted Balanced-A at 70% and 50%, the 95% intervals for score change are [ − 0.34 , 1.11 ] [-0.34,1.11] and [ − 2.10 , − 0.96 ] [-2.10,-0.96] points, respectively, from 5,000 paired bootstrap replicates over natural image/document groups.

Configuration selection searches compression thresholds { 0.65 , 0.84 } \{0.65,0.84\} , crop-selection thresholds { 0.2 , 0.3 , … , 0.8 } \{0.2,0.3,\ldots,0.8\} , and fallback tradeoffs { 0 , 0.05 , … , 2 } \{0,0.05,\ldots,2\} , giving 574 combinations per M/A variant. blocks.en: With both gates enabled, we find the largest feasible FLOPs saving, then choose the highest mean score among candidates within 0.5 percentage points of that saving; ties prefer greater saving. If none meets both limits, selection minimizes the sum of the shortfalls, then the larger shortfall, with savings and score breaking remaining ties. Each target’s selected configuration applies to all test datasets. The tables retain every run and report validation feasibility, including InternVL3-8B Safe-M and Safe-A, feasible in two and three of four runs, respectively.
blocks.zh: 在两个门都启用的情况下,我们发现最大的可行的FLOP储蓄,然后在候选人中选择最高的中分,在储蓄的0.5个百分点之内;纽带更倾向于更大的储蓄。 如果无一符合两个限制,则选择将亏损的总和降至最低,然后是较大的亏损,储蓄和得分打破剩余的联系。 每个目标的选定配置适用于所有测试数据集. 这些表格保留了每次运行和报告验证的可行性,包括InternVL3-8B Safe-M和Safe-A,分别在两次运行和三次运行中可行。

blocks.en: Table S27 lists per-dataset split sizes and scoring rules; the grouped splitting procedure is described in the main paper. For label generation, VQA soft scores are thresholded at 0.6 for TextVQA/VizWiz and ANLS at 0.5 for DocVQA/InfoVQA. Reported task scores retain partial credit.
blocks.zh: 表S27列出了每个数据集的拆分大小和打分规则;主论文中描述了分组拆分程序. 对于标签生成,VQA软分的阈值为:TextVQA/VizWiz0.6,ANLS为:DocVQA/InfoVQA0.5. 报告的任务分数保留部分信用。

blocks.en: Dataset-macro results average datasets equally. Relative score retention averages each dataset’s method-to-original score ratio; three-target means then average the target-specific results.
blocks.zh: 数据集-宏观结果平均数据集相同. 相对积分保留率平均值为每个数据集的方法与原得分比率;三目标表示然后平均特定目标结果.
